chunks.text: Our goal at Easy Tyres & Autos Ltd. is to provide you new and used tyres for the lowest prices in the business. Our team works closely with the largest distributor's to keep prices low while ensuring the highest quality products. Contact us for your next repair or replacement, and visit our store today.
Its our job to in providing you with top quality new and used tyres, Need to get your vehicle up and running but unsure which is the right tyre? Come by the store and we’ll make sure to hook you up.

Every vehicle operates best with new tyres. That’s why we carry a wide selection of tyres from several manufacturers — to ensure your vehicle is up and running at top performance. Our variety of tyres includes our top quality makes to ensure your vehicle is running the best it can be.

Every vehicle operates best with good tyres. That’s why we carry a wide selection of used tyres from several manufacturers — to ensure your vehicle is up and running at top performance in no time. Our variety of used tyres includes top quality tyres that come with different features.
We service all makes and models Services start from £99

The most important thing your car needs is often also the most overlooked. We can provide many different types of auto parts because we understand how vital they are to the overall performance of your vehicle. Call us to book your service.

As part of our impeccable customer service, we make sure you buy only the very best quality tyres for your vehicle. We only work with the best distributors to ensure your satisfaction. Check out some of our popular brands below, and let us know if you’re looking for something specific — we’ll be happy to assist you.
Largest tyre manufacturers in the world.
Bridgestone is a Japanese multinational Tyre company, As of 2017, the company is the largest manufacturer of tyres in the world
2nd largest tyre manufacturers in the world.

Michelin is a French multinational tyre manufacturer based in Clermont-Ferrand in the Auvergne-Rhone-Alpes région of France. It is the second largest tyre manufacturer in the world. In addition to the Michelin brand, it also owns the Kléber tyres company and Uniroyal
Goodyear is an American multinational tyre manufacturing company founded in 1898 by Frank Seiberling and based in Akron, Ohio . Goodyear is one of the top four tyre manufacturers in the world.
4th largest tyre manufacturers in the world.

Continental was founded in 1871 as a rubber manufacturer. In 1898, Continental started development and production of the vehicle tires with plain tread, which was the major success of the brand. In 1904, Continental became the first company in the world to manufacture grooved vehicle tires.

Devante have been manufacturing for the past decade and strive to become a leading name in the business. Davanti Tyres combine expert engineering, advanced manufacturing processes, extensive testing and progressive development. There tyres allow the driver to get the most out of their vehicle's performance capabilities, delivering excellent value for money.

LANDSAIL / DELINTE (formerly the Sentaida Group ) is a Chinese manufacturer of tires for cars and aviation. In 2015, it was ranked the 50th largest tire maker in the world by sales according to the trade publication "Tire Business".
Look no further - your dream Tire Shop is here! Come in and be amazed by our vast selection and incredible prices.
York House, 55 Easy Rd, Leeds LS9 8QS, UK
